advantages: Existing opponent-family-local normalization; no hidden task ID injected into actor or critic
evaluations: Fixed64cases per family against actual Nexto at0,10,25,50 and every50; fixed ten regulation Nexto matches at0 and every50
initialization: Same parent weights, Adam moments and counters; new declared reward/curriculum lineage; not fresh random or BC
kl: Telemetry only; no KL rejection, rollback or retention objective

match_method.diagnostic_match_reward: Existing match runtime reward buffers unused by policy/optimizer
match_method.hidden: zero initially and on every native kickoff reset; continuous otherwise
match_method.interpretation: Small deterministic development comparison, not SSL proof or ranked play
match_method.resets: Existing full-match goal/tied-regulation kickoff only; no no-touch resets
match_method.unresolved_overtime: report unresolved; never count as a win

model: Unchanged entity attention recurrent joint90; native182 observation, no task ID, one deployed policy
nexto: Pinned15Hz inference/stock kickoff; no Rival scripted action or prefix
opponents: Fixed even world slots Nexto, odd current self-play. Exactly one third of learner decisions against Nexto; current learner is task focal side vs Nexto. Both current agents train in self-play
policy_sampling: Categorical during training; deterministic argmax in evaluation
resume: Same lineage model/Adam/counters/RNG; fresh physical episodes and zero hidden, fixed opponent slots, task focal side reloaded from new episode
review: If first50 updates do not improve task outcomes and natural play, diagnose before another large unchanged block

reward.approach: challenge/finishing only before first touch: .5/30 times clamp(speed toward ball/2300,0,1)
reward.clear: Defense only: own native contact turns a previously goal-bound shot into no goal-bound shot; clear bonus after8 safe decisions without opponent touch. Ground/low-ball projection only; task proxy not universal native save event
reward.control: Own native contact since last opponent contact, ball distance<=250uu, relative speed<=500uu/s, opponent distance>=own+150uu, for8 consecutive decisions
reward.failure: Skill time-limit ending without a role success: -1; true goal never also timeout failure
reward.forward_control: After paid control gain, retain same physical control and advance canonical ball y by400uu
reward.kickoff: Control/advancement rewarded whether first or second to touch. No waiting/fake/speedflip event reward, no scripted Rival prefix, no guarantee fake strategy emerges
reward.limits: Each event at most once per player episode; no automatic rearming after success; skill episode12s, natural30s/no-touch15s
reward.lost_control: challenge/kickoff only: after paid control, opponent establishes8-decision control, at most-.5
reward.natural: Unchanged seven-potential FreshGround reward and +/-10 native goal outcome
reward.projection: Linearly extrapolate xy to goal plane y=+/-5120; z=max(93.15,z+vz*t-325*t*t). No wall/bounce prediction; initial ground threats validated with native rollout
reward.role_success: challenge/kickoff:control gain; finishing:on-target touch or goal; defense:shot clear or control gain or goal
reward.shaping_policy_invariance: Only natural lane is potential-based. Direct skill bonuses intentionally change the training objective as requested
reward.shot: Own native contact, planar goal-line projection within750uu of center, predicted height<=550uu, time in(0,4]s, canonical vy>500uu/s
reward.skills: Only +/-10 native goal outcome, below one-shot task events and bounded approach
reward.terminal: Native first-goal physics tick, discounted within four-tick hold; later tick remainder absorbing
reward.truncation: Pre-reset final observation bootstrap, GAE cut; skill success does not terminate

rollout: 90 decisions/3seconds,4physics ticks each, complete recurrent sequences; goal resets hidden; truncate bootstrap before reset
safety: Finite model/gradient/Adam checks and whole-update corruption rollback preserved
selection: No cherry-picked checkpoint; scheduled snapshots, compare parent0 on identical cases
snapshots: Every accepted update rolling; permanent at0,10,25,50 and each50 afterward
stop: User stop or operational/nonfinite/corruption fault; report failures and do not silently change frozen reward coefficients
